title: A gate about the coord hook's lease token or a lease release is not classed secrets or push
goal: bl_authority.class_reasons reads a coord lease's token (`lease token`) and a coord lease release (`release` beside lease or SessionEnd) as no secrets or push words, so such a gate takes the class its touches give (agents-rule for .claude/hooks/) and is not handled as a secret or a push. Found by the SP-4cc36epy close: BG-ljlj77kd's gates were classed push (matched 'release') and secrets (matched 'token').

run:
import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_authority as a
it={'touches':['.claude/hooks/coord_hook.py']}
q=[{'id':'g1','question':'How does the coord hook make a SessionEnd release that could not run reach the store once it is free?','options':['retry at next SessionStart','wait longer inside SessionEnd']},
